headline: Red Sox look to bounce back against Orioles after painful loss
morning_brew: I'm still trying to shake off that Seattle game. It felt like watching a slow-motion car crash where nobody bothered to hit the brakes. Giving up eight runs with that kind of early deficit is the quickest way to ruin a perfectly good Tuesday night in the Hub. My neighbor Rick is already convinced the rotation is cursed, and after watching the starter walk three and give up four runs in a few innings, it is hard to tell him he is wrong. We were chasing the game from the jump, and that is not a spot this lineup is built to thrive in.

The bats actually put up a decent fight, with Abreu and Anthony both looking sharp at the plate, but it was just too little too late. Watching the team rally for a couple of runs in the middle innings only to have the pitching staff give the momentum right back is the kind of stuff that makes you wanna throw your Dunks at the screen. Even cousin Jimmy could tell you that you cannot spot a major league team that many runs and expect to walk away with a win, regardless of how hard the top of the order works to scrape back.

Now we have to turn the page and get ready for a four-game set down in Baltimore. If we do not start getting some consistent command from the mound, this September stretch is going to be a long, miserable slog. I am choosing to stay optimistic because that is what we do around here, but the margin for error is shrinking by the day. Let us get out of Maryland with a series win and finally put this recent slump in the rearview mirror.

news_digest.headline: Orioles begin 4-game series with the Red Sox
news_digest.dans_take: If we play like we did last night, Baltimore is gonna eat us for lunch, so let us wake up.

news_digest.dans_take: I do not care if we are ranked first or last, just show me some friggin' heart on the field.

trend_watch.dans_take: That was an absolute disaster of a start that left the bullpen to finish a shift they never should have clocked into.
He was the only guy at the dish who remembered how to find the barrel, and he deserves a steak dinner for carrying the load.

trend_watch.dans_take: The kid is playing like he is auditioning for a statue on Yawkey Way, and honestly, I am here for it.
